Arithmetic cross-check for tests/fixtures/judge_eval_set.py
=============================================================
Ran independently of any judge/LLM output, before labelling, via:

    python3 -c "
    import math
    print('17*23=', 17*23)
    print('144/12=', 144/12)
    print('15% of 240=', 0.15*240)
    print('sqrt169=', math.isqrt(169))
    print('7+8*2=', 7+8*2)
    print('123-47=', 123-47)
    "

Output:
    17*23= 391
    144/12= 12.0
    15% of 240= 36.0
    sqrt169= 13
    7+8*2= 23
    123-47= 76

These values are the ground truth behind the "correct" labels for arith-01,
arith-03, arith-05, arith-07, arith-09, and the numeric parts of arith-11/12
and fact-12 (76 is even, so "odd" in arith-12's response is wrong; 1789 is
the year Washington took office, so "1788" in fact-12's response is wrong).
